sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
NVS Visuals is a full-service experiential production company based in NYC that specializes in event graphics, fabrication, mobile experiential campaigns, and brand activations.

Industry: Marketing and Advertising Services · HQ: New York, United States · Size: <$50M · Products: Large Format UV Printing, Experiential Vehicles, Custom Fabrication, Brand Activations, CNC Milling, Vinyl Wrapping

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: NVS Visuals scores 39 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (25/25) and pain-point alignment (10/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and event engagement, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on graffiti resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (33% similar on vinyl, printing, vehicle, print); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (24% similar on vinyl, graphics, vehicle, fleet); Drytac (17% similar on print, graphics, vinyl, printing). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
